title: Matrix Product State Theory of Few-Photon Squeezed Pulses Interacting with a Two-Level Emitter in a Waveguide
summary: Squeezed light states have a special place in quantum optics with potentially profound applications in emerging quantum technologies. We present a numerically-exact matrix product states (MPS) approach to model quantum pulses of squeezed light, at the few-photon level, interacting with a two-level system in a waveguide environment. We represent the squeezed state as a coherent superposition of Fock states and explore the nonlinear population dynamics as well as multi-photon correlation functions that emerge.
